# Third-Party Licenses

This directory preserves license texts/notices from a reference Python runtime
used during ATAP development.

Captured versions identify the source of these license files only; they are not
ATAP dependency pins.

| Component | Captured version |
|---|---:|
| NumPy | 2.3.5 |
| GeoPandas | 1.1.2 |
| Rasterio | 1.5.0 |
| Shapely | 2.1.2 |
| SciPy | 1.17.0 |
| pandas | 2.2.3 |
| pyproj | 3.7.2 |

When dependency versions or packaging methods change, refresh this directory
and review the exact release artifacts.
